column1: # LIVE — Last real data refresh: 2026-06-30 (newest filed quarter) | Staleness sweep: 2026-09-27 (header caveats added twice 9/27) | Next: Q3-2026 10-Q ~2026-11-06

# NON-ACCRUAL FLOW LEDGER — the decomposition THESIS v1.0 rests on. Built 2026-08-28 by FLG at its first live session from 13 EDGAR filings (10-Q/10-K, Flagstar Bank N.A., CIK 0000910073, 2023Q2..2026Q2). Source-authority: PRIMARY — FLG pulled and parsed every filing itself.

# ⚠️ BASIS IS LOAD-BEARING AND DECLARED PER ROW. `YTD-as-filed` = figures exactly as printed: CUMULATIVE FROM DEC 31 of the prior year, NOT quarterly. `Q-derived` = successive YTD differences within one fiscal year, computed by FLG, NOT a filed figure. Never mix the two in one comparison; never annualise a YTD row (the ×2 error that overstated the seed's charge-offs ~15%).
# ⚠️ EXPECTED-STALE BY CONSTRUCTION between filings — quarterly regulatory cadence, as with MI3_FLG.tsv. Stale after ~2026-11-13 IS neglect.

# IDENTITY CHECK: begin + new + acquired + charge-offs + transfers + payoffs + cures = end, per filing. 13/13 TIE EXACTLY. Not decoration — it caught two real parser defects at build: a missing 'acquired from acquisition' category, and a line reading 'New non-accrual, INCLUDING acquired from acquisition' that matched two labels and double-counted the inflow. A row that does not tie must not be used.

# ⚠️ ADDED 2026-09-27 (KB-FLG-061/063, REGINALD ASK 9/26) — THE 'chargeoffs' LEG IS NOT ALL CHARGE-OFFS, AND 'payoffs_dispositions' IS NOT PROOF OF PAR EXIT. The ACL roll-forward's gross charge-offs exceed this schedule's charge-off line by 50–73% in EVERY period checked (FY23 223 vs 97 · FY24 938 vs 256 · FY25 449 vs 185 · Q1-26 113 vs 40 · Q2-26 120 vs 60; $M). Where the gap sits is not determinable from disclosure. Loss taken AT EXIT is ONE candidate, but the gap does NOT scale with payoff volume (11%–350% of payoffs; FY2023 gap 3.5x payoffs — KB-FLG-066), so appraisal write-downs on ACCRUING loans fit at least as well. Neither leads. Shares here stay arithmetically correct on the schedule's own lines — never read the payoff share as 'exited without loss'. ALSO: the H1-26 payoff leg is LUMPY (Q1 $646M vs Q2 $190M), 'primarily' ONE bankrupt borrower relationship resolved in Q1-26 — the 87.5% is one-relationship-weighted, not a steady-state rate.

# ⚠️ ADDED 2026-09-27 23:49 ET (KB-FLG-067/069/070) — (1) The Q1-26 payoff leg ($646M) very likely contains the PINNACLE bankruptcy sale (PRESS-GRADE; issuer does not name it): $451.3M price vs >$564M Flagstar debt, closed 3/31/26, with FLAGSTAR FINANCING THE BUYER $338.5M (~75%). An 'outflow' on this ledger is therefore NOT necessarily exposure leaving the bank; buyer-financing is undisclosed for every other exit. (2) This ledger does not track modifications: MF modifications began in 2026 (none in 2025); the 12-month MF modified stock was 47% past due at 6/30 — a changing aggregate population, NOT a cohort failure rate (Will, 9/27 20:49 ET). A modified loan can sit in accrual, so it may not appear in these flows at all.

# ⚠️ COHORT-INCOMPARABLE, verified by REGINALD 2026-08-28 (n=3 at primary): WAL/EGBN/CFG disclose ACL roll-forwards but NOT non-accrual roll-forwards; the cure line is FR Y-14Q Schedule H (non-public). No peer denominator exists for these shares. Treat every share here as a SINGLE-NAME time series, never as a cohort percentile.
# SIGN CONVENTION: inflows positive, outflows negative. total_outflow is the POSITIVE magnitude of all outflow legs; shares are of total_outflow.
